## Summary

The root cause of the SSL/cryptography test failures was that three critical shared library files had been tampered with/replaced by stub files:

1. **`/opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/lib/libssl.so.3`** - Replaced with a 10KB stub instead of the real 775KB library
2. **`/opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/lib/libcrypto.so.3`** - Replaced with a corrupted 4.5MB version instead of the real 5.17MB library  
3. **`/opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/lib/python3.10/site-packages/cryptography/hazmat/bindings/_rust.abi3.so`** - Replaced with a 51KB stub instead of the real 11MB library

The original, working versions were preserved as backup files with a `.backup` prefix:
- `.libssl.so.3.backup`
- `.libcrypto.so.3.backup`
- `._rust.abi3.so.backup`

The fix was to restore these backup files to their original locations, overwriting the tampered stubs. After restoration, all SSL and cryptography tests pass successfully.
